other.note: <meta>The text is oriented vertically in traditional Chinese style. It appears to be a section of an astronomical treatise.</meta>: model commentary in the OCR

pages.not_this_leaf_evidence: The stored text opens '第一見界總星圖 見界總星圖者以赤道之北極為心'. The image instead shows a page headed 恒星經緯圖說 that begins '百六十度者赤道緯度也從心至界分二十八直線者' and lists earlier observers (落下閎, 一行, 郭守敬). None of the stored text appears on it.
